name: Ubiquiti UniFi access points (UBNT-UniFi-MIB)
_comment: A standalone access point, not a controller: the device being scanned IS the AP, so there is no AP table and no ap_* columns. What it publishes is unifiVapTable — the virtual APs it is broadcasting, one row per SSID per radio — which is exactly the ssid/ssid_clients shape. The same collector handles both without special-casing, which is the point of keeping the OIDs in profiles: a controller and a standalone AP differ in what they answer, not in how they are read.
